authority_rules: A Portfolio PIN/claim owns the bounded deploy job but does not by itself grant Supabase mutation authority.

The active human/durable authority must explicitly permit mutation/deployment of Supabase project catnohyouxqjjtseaueb and function study-transcribe-v1, or a broader durable authority that unambiguously covers both.
Authorization limited to GitHub/repository commits is insufficient for Supabase deployment.
No token, service-role key, room token or other secret may be copied into the job, receipt or repository.

secret_handling.runtime_environment: Reuse existing Supabase-managed environment bindings without reading their values.

pre_deploy_evidence_required: Atomic job authority/PIN and STARTED receipt.
Pinned source blob SHA and exact entrypoint bytes.
Fresh live metadata for current Served version, ezbr_sha256 and verify_jwt.
A rollback snapshot/ref of the currently Served source returned by the connected Supabase read surface, excluding environment secret values.

deployment_contract.mechanism: Supabase Edge Function deploy action against project catnohyouxqjjtseaueb
deployment_contract.verify_jwt_basis: Current Served v7 has verify_jwt=false and implements application-level room authorization with session_id + room_token; changing this flag is a separate contract change, not an incidental deploy detail.
deployment_contract.source_rule: Deploy only the bytes pinned by the job; do not silently substitute mutable HEAD.

post_deploy_evidence_required: Fresh live Edge Function metadata with status, version, ezbr_sha256 and verify_jwt.
Fresh readback of the deployed entrypoint sufficient to bind Served behavior to the intended candidate source/semantic delta.
Read-only bounded health/selftest evidence appropriate to the candidate; a GET probe cannot prove private-audio E2E acceptance.
A durable RETURN that records previous Served identity, new Served identity, source pin, authority ref, tests and any boundary without secrets.
served_identity_rule: Repository source is Candidate until post-deploy live metadata/readback binds it to a Served version/digest. A successful deploy call alone is not sufficient evidence of Served identity.

rollback_contract.rollback_source: Use the pre-deploy Served source snapshot/ref captured before mutation, never an assumed historical repository version.
rollback_contract.trigger: If post-deploy identity/readback cannot be verified or bounded health evidence fails, mark DEPLOY_VERIFY_BOUNDARY; rollback only under valid mutation authority.

current_baseline.truth_boundary: Baseline metadata is evidence for this contract, not permission to mutate or a promise that it remains current at future deploy time.

prohibited: Treating GitHub write authority as Supabase mutation authority.
Creating a parallel deployment scheduler, queue, bridge or authority owner.
Reading or persisting Supabase secret values.
Promoting Current, Catalog, Served or Human Accepted without their own evidence/authority.
